name: learning-coach
description: Learn within Topics, plan across a learning portfolio, inspect progress, and maintain a private GitHub-backed Learning Vault.

interface.shortDescription: Learn inside Topics and plan across your learning portfolio
interface.longDescription: Use Learning Coach for Topic-local teaching, practice, assessment, roadmap, and learner-state updates; Ask Coach for portfolio-level prioritization, global review scheduling, cross-Topic reasoning, candidate Topics, durable Coach State, and evidence-backed Learning Strategy; Learning View for read-only presentation; Vault Curator for maintenance.
defaultPrompt: Use Learning Coach to resume a chosen Topic and continue from its next useful within-Topic action.
Use Ask Coach to decide what I should learn, review, practice, connect, defer, or explore across my Topics.
Show my current learning state without changing it.
Recommend whether I should open a new Topic and remember durable candidate Topics when useful.
Review my Learning Vault for structural issues and propose safe refactors.
